CONF_SENTENCE.formatted: they gave the same valence on 3,238 units and differed on 412, of which 407 were one step apart.

H2_DIRECTION.formatted: All determined correlations are positive: within category, brands with higher Presence received warmer descriptions, the failure the v1.7 lesson warns of. At $t_1$ and $t_2$ it was in the marginal band, not below it.

H2_FIRM.formatted: The H2 verdict rests on one wave at or above the 0.50 line (0.5013 at $t_3$) and two in the marginal band.

H8_OVER.formatted: one of the three determined waves ($t_2$)

H7_DIRECTION.formatted: The correlation is positive, the same direction as H2.

H2_ROBUST.formatted: No variant put H2 in the confirmed band, and the correlation with Presence was positive at every determined wave in the primary analysis and in all eight variants (Table 7); S-CUT, S-CUT-M and J2-scored S give MARGINAL, the others FALSIFIED. The falsification is narrow, not a sign that Sentiment is separable from Presence, and the pre-registered verdict, H2 FALSIFIED, stands.
